prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080.

SCENE: A friendly cartoon NOROVIRUS character — the "stomach bug" virus — sitting cheerfully inside a giant cartoon SMALL INTESTINE shown as a simple wide cut-away tunnel with soft wavy walls. The norovirus is a big chunky round ball whose whole surface is covered in large ROUNDED BUMPS packed side by side, with round scooped DIMPLES sunk between them, like a raspberry or a golf ball with big thumb-pressed dents. It has NO spikes, NO rays, NO stalks and NO fuzzy coat — only chunky rounded bumps and dimples. It has a BIG FRIENDLY FACE: two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful curved eyebrows and a wide happy grin, plus two little stubby arms, one of them waving.
Around it in the same scene: two or three smiling gut-lining cell characters standing along the floor and wall of the tunnel, each a simple rounded tall block with a friendly face and a row of wavy hair-like fringes along its top; a large chunky bar of SOAP with a pair of friendly cartoon HANDS scrubbing it, releasing a few big round outlined soap bubbles that drift toward the virus; and a tall glass of WATER with a bendy straw and a couple of big round outlined bubbles in it, standing on the tunnel floor. Everything is drawn large, simple and chunky so a child can colour inside every shape. The mood is playful and reassuring — nobody is sick, nobody looks unwell, nothing unpleasant is shown.

STYLE — coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with generous white space inside them.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN — the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines or halo of rays behind, around or under the character. No radiating lines of any kind. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES of the square — the intestine tunnel, its floor and the background elements run right off the top, bottom, left and right edges with no white margin band and no enclosing outline.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO lipid envelope or membrane around the virus, NO spikes, NO rays, NO tail, NO legs beyond the two little stubby arms.
- NOTHING gruesome or unpleasant: no vomit, no sick or distressed faces, no toilet, no bad smell lines, no green clouds.
